svg.title: A screw head coupled to its bearing ring: undeformed, kinematic and distributing
svg.desc: Three sections around the hole of a plate whose lower face is fixed, cut through the screw axis, each with a fine structured grid on the cut face and the back half of the hole visible between the two sides. A point on the axis is joined by legs to the ring of the top face around the hole and carries the screw force. Undeformed, the plate is flat. With a kinematic coupling the ring is pressed in flat. With a distributing coupling the ring dishes, deepest at the hole edge.
svg.text: Undeformed: the point is coupled to the head’s ring
Kinematic (RBE2): the ring is pressed in flat
Distributing (RBE3): the ring dishes, deepest at the hole
section y = 0 · lower face fixed · displacements enlarged 2000×
